_doc: Alert-name -> Grafana view attached to the ServiceNow incident (DEMO-8 / #60). Loaded by agents.auto_ticketing on every ticket-create attempt; failure to render or attach must NOT break ticket creation. Keys are Prometheus alert rule names (the `alert` field in demo/otel-demo/values.yaml serverFiles.alerting_rules). Keys starting with `_` are reserved for documentation entries like this one and are filtered out at load time. `dashboard_uid` is the stable id from the dashboard's URL (.../d/<UID>/...). RENDER MODE: OMIT `panel_id` to render the WHOLE dashboard in kiosk mode (no nav chrome) — use this to attach a dashboard's summary/Overview row as one image; collapsed rows stay collapsed. INCLUDE `panel_id` (from 'Inspect -> Panel JSON') to render a single panel via d-solo. `time_range` is a single relative window (e.g. `15m`, `6h`); `width`/`height` size the PNG (dashboards want a taller height, e.g. 860). INTENTIONAL: all four demo alerts point at the SAME dashboard (the Collector Overview) as a shared telemetry-health snapshot — not a service-specific panel per alert. To give an alert its own view, add an entry with that dashboard_uid + panel_id.
_verify: Validated 2026-07-06 against the running OTel demo (grafana-image-renderer enabled via demo/otel-demo/values.yaml). All demo alerts attach the OpenTelemetry Collector dashboard's 'Overview' (dashboard_uid `otel-demo_otel-collector_dashboard`, no panel_id -> full-dashboard kiosk render at 1000x860). Only the 'Overview' row is expanded on that dashboard, so the shot shows the Service table + Receivers/Processors/Exporters throughput (Spans/Logs/Metrics) + error/drop gauges, with the other rows as thin collapsed bars. render_panel returns a real ~85KB PNG. Note: full-dashboard renders lean harder on the image-renderer's headless Chromium; an occasional 503 under memory pressure is non-fatal (ticket still created, no attachment that time).
